About Me

I turn complex
problems into elegant
experiences.

I'm Adithya — a Product Designer II with 5 years building end-to-end products from 0-to-1 across web and mobile, for both D2C and B2B. I combine user research, data, and rapid prototyping to ship work that measurably improves conversion, retention, and adoption.

I build scalable design systems and AI-augmented workflows that raise both speed and quality — including first-of-their-kind interactive experiences and self-built AI tooling. Currently designing at ACKO, Bengaluru.

Career

Where I've
been building.

Aug 2023 – Present
Bengaluru
0 to 1 Design Systems B2B Growth AI-Augmented
  • Led 0-to-1 design of ACKO Drive Service Center — validated demand with a Fake Door test (17% CTR), MVP lifted visit-to-lead conversion from 33% to 55%, V1 delivered a 212% uplift in serviceable-user conversion and 82% booking success.
  • Redesigned ADSC 2.0 and templatized into a reusable component system — rapidly launched 900+ city-level SEO pages, lifting ACKO Drive into Google's top-10 rankings.
  • Revamped Used Car Valuation journey — raised CTR from 11% to 16%, grew inspection bookings 31%, drove 61% MoM growth in procurements; optimized the inspection form to lift completion from 59% to 72%.
  • Designed ACKO's first-of-its-kind 3D interactive storefront (acko.com/enterprise) across 5 product categories — secured alignment from Design leadership, VP of Product, and PMs.
  • Built the ACKO Employer Portal and its design system from scratch — V1 and endorsement flows adopted by 90+ entities and 70+ partner groups.
  • Designed and built Ultron, an internal generative-AI social-media visual generator — adopted by the marketing team and being scaled company-wide.
  • Embedded AI tools (Cursor, Claude, Codex, Figma Make) into the design workflow; at Ackathon 2026, independently designed and coded a fully working product end-to-end without a developer.
Feb – Jul 2023
Hyderabad
SaaS B2B Dashboards No-Code
  • Reimagined the Call Log interface for Banter (cloud-based business communication), adding contextual call details to elevate usability.
  • Redesigned the GoRummy B2B management platform with new modules and dashboards, amplifying insights and operational efficiency.
  • Enhanced Uncode, a no-code app builder — systemised iconography, designed new modules and form UI, created product logos and branded assets.
Jul 2021 – Jan 2023
Hyderabad
User Research Usability Testing
  • Facilitated user research and usability testing with frontline agents to identify workflow bottlenecks in internal tools.

Jul 2021 – Nov 2023
Hyderabad
0 to 1 Branding Mobile
